scope: Qualified local macOS arm64; unpublished owner review candidate, not full v0.1.

code_review.maintainability: Central operation/CLI/type facades are larger than focused media modules; the largest production file is the 733-line atomic store dispatcher. That transaction boundary was reviewed explicitly. Further splitting is a maintainability choice, not a claim that every file is small or that community review has already accepted the code.

known_limits: Local macOS arm64 and recorded topology only: Chrome host/host UDP ICE, native PCMU/QUIC and Telnyx registration/NAT. WAN/TURN, mobile, arbitrary carriers and physical audio hardware are not qualified.

Each configured local audio channel holds at most ten 20 ms frames (200 ms). Multiple stages and provider/model/network/playout latency are separate; overloaded realtime queues deliberately drop frames.

Newest model-visible context items have a 32 KiB budget with explicit omissions; the original authorized journal remains. Automatic summaries, pinned facts and perfect ASR/model recall are future work.
